lines.en: Hi Eva! Did you talk to the ranger about the lake?
lines.pt: Oi, Eva! Você falou com a guarda sobre o lago?

lines.en: Yes. She said the lake was frozen, but the ice was thin.
lines.pt: Sim. Ela disse que o lago estava congelado, mas o gelo estava fino.

lines.en: Really? Did she say we could skate there?
lines.pt: Sério? Ela disse que podíamos patinar lá?

lines.en: No. She told me that skating was not safe this week.
lines.pt: Não. Ela me disse que patinar não era seguro esta semana.

lines.en: What did the weather forecast say?
lines.pt: O que a previsão do tempo disse?

lines.en: It said that it was getting warmer every day.
lines.pt: Disse que estava ficando mais quente a cada dia.

lines.en: My brother said that the dock was closed, and the boats were in the garage.
lines.pt: Meu irmão disse que o cais estava fechado e os barcos estavam na garagem.

lines.en: That makes sense. The ranger said that people should stay on the shore.
lines.pt: Faz sentido. A guarda disse que as pessoas deviam ficar na margem.

lines.en: Did she say anything about fishing?
lines.pt: Ela disse alguma coisa sobre pescar?

lines.en: She said that fishing was fine near the shore, but she told me to be careful.
lines.pt: Ela disse que pescar era bom perto da margem, mas me disse para ter cuidado.

lines.en: Good. I told my mother that we could go on Sunday, so let’s bring warm coats.
lines.pt: Bom. Eu disse à minha mãe que poderíamos ir no domingo, então vamos levar casacos quentes.

work.title: Stranger Than Fiction
work.note: Stranger Than Fiction é uma comédia dramática de 2006, dirigida por Marc Forster, sobre um homem que começa a ouvir a narração de uma escritora sobre a própria vida. Combina com falar de ficção e de histórias. A cena é autoral; não adapta nem cita a obra. A referência mostra um autor dentro da própria história: the story is about….

items.wrong: She said me that the lake was frozen.
items.fix: She told me that the lake was frozen.
items.why: Use told me, não said me.

items.wrong: She said that the ice is thin.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: She said me that the lake was frozen. → She told me that the lake was frozen. | She said that the ice is thin. → She said that the ice was thin. | She told that skating was not safe. → She told me that skating was not safe..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.big: She said the lake was frozen
facts.label: Discurso indireto
facts.sub: Depois de said ou told me, o verbo vai para o passado: she said the lake was frozen, she told me that it was thin.

facts.label: disse que…
facts.sub: Depois de said, o verbo recua um passo: the lake is frozen vira the lake was frozen. Exemplo: She said the lake was frozen. O that é opcional.

facts.label: disse a alguém
facts.sub: Use told com a pessoa: She told me that skating was not safe. Nunca use said me; use told me. Veja também told her, told us.

compare.ask: She said the lake was frozen.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela disse que o lago estava congelado” e “ela me disse que era perigoso”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She said the lake was frozen.”
compare.us: Em inglês, depois de said use o verbo no passado: she said the lake was frozen (original: the lake is frozen). Com told, ponha a pessoa: she told me that skating was not safe. Não diga said me.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She said the lake was frozen reports a statement.
items.why: Yes.
We say she told me that…

items.s: After said we often use the past.
items.why: Yes.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She said the lake was frozen reports a statement. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She said me that…”. → Falso (We say she told me that…)
After said we often use the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.why: She said that / she said.

items.s: We use the same tense as the original words.
items.why: We usually go one step back.

pages.instruction: Mais uma rodada: decida e explique.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The word that is optional. → Verdadeiro (She said that / she said.)
We use the same tense as the original words. → Falso (We usually go one step back.)
